name: Vortex Indicator System
summary: This EA implements the Vortex Indicator system, which uses two oscillating lines (VI+ and VI-) to identify trend direction and momentum. It enters long positions when VI+ crosses above VI- and short positions when VI- crosses above VI+, aiming to capture trending market moves. The system is a systematic trend-following EA with configurable parameters for indicator periods and trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了Vortex指标系统，使用两条振荡线（VI+和VI-）来识别趋势方向和动量。当VI+上穿VI-时做多，VI-上穿VI+时做空，旨在捕捉趋势行情。这是一个系统化的趋势跟踪EA，具有可配置的指标周期和交易管理参数。
strategy_analysis: Vortex Indicator System基于Vortex指标（漩涡指标）进行趋势跟踪交易。该指标通过计算正向运动（VM+）和负向运动（VM-）的比值来生成VI+和VI-两条线，当VI+上穿VI-时产生做多信号，当VI-上穿VI+时产生做空信号。入场条件完全依赖VI+/VI-交叉信号，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。出场条件可能包括固定止损止盈或反向交叉信号。仓位管理方面使用固定手数或可配置的手数参数。资金管理方面缺乏动态仓位调整机制，风险控制依赖于固定止损。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现良好，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The Vortex Indicator System trades based on the Vortex Indicator, which generates two lines (VI+ and VI-) from the ratio of positive and negative vortex movements. Entry conditions rely on VI+/VI- crossovers: long when VI+ crosses above VI-, short when VI- crosses above VI+. Exit conditions likely include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels or reversal crossover signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot or configurable lot parameter without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management lacks adaptive position sizing, relying on static stop-loss for risk control. The strategy performs well in trending markets but suffers from frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy conditions.

pros: 趋势行情中能捕捉较大波段利润
Vortex指标逻辑清晰，信号直观易懂
参数简洁，便于用户调整和优化
pros_en: Captures significant trend moves in directional markets
Vortex Indicator logic is clear and signals are intuitive to interpret
Simple parameter set makes it easy for users to adjust and optimize
cons: 震荡市中频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏动态仓位管理和自适应止损机制
单一指标依赖，无多时间框架确认或过滤机制
cons_en: Frequent false signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic position sizing and adaptive stop-loss mechanisms
Relies on a single indicator without multi-timeframe confirmation or filtering
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，如H4趋势方向过滤H1信号
添加ATR动态止损和仓位管理，根据市场波动调整风险敞口
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., use H4 trend direction to filter H1 signals
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and position sizing to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility

risk_points: 单一指标交叉信号在震荡市中容易反复触发造成连续亏损
固定手数无资金管理，大资金时风险敞口不可控
risk_points_en: Single indicator crossover signals can repeatedly trigger in ranging markets causing consecutive losses
Fixed lot size without money management makes risk exposure uncontrollable for large accounts
